name: new_v1_trace_and_spd_wearing_increment_v1
source_fit: For each subject, source training-domain windows fit F0v2 Rest thresholds, fixed-shrinkage trace covariance and log-Euclidean SPD reference. Source native trials alone fit each scaler and balanced LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924; target wearing domains are transform-only.
selection: Compare F0v2, F0v2+document F2b, F0v2+F2a and F0v2+F2c only on matched validation-subject trials; final subjects are descriptive. Do not promote from a single wearing axis.
boundary: Public eight-channel 200 Hz same-user wearing-domain spatial family screen. F2a and F2c use centered, shrunken source-frozen covariance; F2b uses the separate uncentered CSP equation. No historical-family, own-device or cross-day claim.
